S25 Ultra- Generative Edit 

S25 Ultra - Your New Styling Partner 

S25 Ultra - Now Brief 

S25 Ultra - Search and Message 

S25 Ultra - Intro 

Personalized briefings 

Get personalized briefings throughout the day from the all-new Now Brief. Start your morning with a run-down of the day ahead. Then recap on the day's events in the evening with daily activity insights. 
Circle it, find it. Hear it, find it 

Circle to Search with Google allows you to instantly search anything on your screen. Just circle an object-including images, videos or text-with your finger or the S Pen, and you'll get results immediately. You can even search for a song that you hear in the moment without switching apps. 
A sound studio at your fingertips 

Filter out unwanted background noise from your videos and make them share-worthy with Audio Eraser. Galaxy Al fine-tunes your audio by adjusting different types of sound including voices, music, wind and more. 
Personal data stays personal 

The Personal Data Engine combines and processes your primary data and provides tailored suggestions. It encrypts this data and saves it on your device with Knox Vault, making it inaccessible to anyone else. 
Now Bar, Widget and Notification 

Get Now Briefs at a glance from the all-new Now Bar. Directly access Now Brief and more from the new Now Bar. 
Personalize with the new layouts and redesigned widgets. 
Monitor what's in action with Live notifications. 
The most advanced Al ProVisual Engine 

Our next-gen ProVisual Engine is now boosted by our powerful processor-allowing you to capture, view and edit for our best camera and editing experience yet. 
Epic portraits, every single time 

Our Object-aware Engine detects light in the environment and precisely recognizes subjects. Flaunt your natural skin tones and textures exactly as your eyes see them. 
Unrivaled Nightography video. Less noise, more clarity 

Now you can shoot in improved 10-bit HDR for a more stunning videography experience. Our advanced AP also delivers more precise noise removal meaning you won't have to worry about grainy night footage again. 
The sharpest details from Wide to Tele and even Ultra Wide 

From Ultra Wide shots to our Telephoto camera, photos are clear and vivid at any angle. Our Al enhanced ProVisual Engine then improves color and details for next-level clarity. 
Processor 

The most powerful processor custom-made for Galaxy 
ProScaler 

ProScaler enhances resolution by using advanced Al-algorithm processing to deliver a viewing experience in high definition without having to adjust the display settings. 
Battery 

Our pioneering mDNle technology has been built into our customized AP, and with software optimization, battery usage time is enhanced so you can enjoy hours of watching videos.

What AI features are available? 
Galaxy S25 Ultra uses AI to get your apps working together with a single ask. It also comes with extra AI features such as Now Brief, Gemini Live and Audio Eraser. Thanks to the upgraded One UI 7, these features work seamlessly on Galaxy S25 Ultra. 
How large is the memory and storage capacity of the Galaxy S25 Series? 
Galaxy S25 Series offers the most memory capacity at 12GB. Galaxy S25 Ultra offers a storage capacity of up to 1TB. 
How is the camera better than Galaxy S24 Ultra? 
Galaxy S25 Ultra offers clearer night videos with Nightography . The Object aware Engine makes for life like portraits in diverse lighting conditions. And the new Ultra Wide 50 MP camera captures high resolution photos at all ranges including macro. 
How good is Galaxy S25 Ultra's battery? 
Galaxy S25 Ultra’s battery allows for the longest video playback time out of Galaxy S24 Ultra, S23 Ultra, S22 Ultra, and S21 Ultra. The video playback time has been extended by 31 hours, which is 1 hour longer than Galaxy S24 Ultra. 
How is my data protected on Galaxy S25 Ultra? 
Galaxy AI processes personalized data securely on your device through the Personal Data Engine. The data is then encrypted to restrict random access by other applications. In Control, choose how to process data or opt out of personalization.

Galaxy S26 Ultra - Privacy Display 

Galaxy S26 Ultra - Photo Assist 

Galaxy S26 Ultra - Nightography 

Galaxy S26 Ultra - Super Steady Video 

Galaxy S26 Ultra- Ravindra Jadeja & Sanjay Manjrekar 

Galaxy S26 Ultra- 360 View 

Compare your device 

Refined design 

The new ambient island camera design flows seamlessly into the rest of the device for a refined finish. 
Sleek and durable 

Crafted with an Armor Aluminum frame, fitted with Corning Gorilla Glass and engineered for water resistance, this Galaxy is as tough as it is sophisticated. 
Our slimmest Ultra yet 

The balanced design delivers our slimmest Ultra yet, bringing together elegance and comfort that fits naturally in your hand. 
Customized processor for Galaxy 

Our powerful processor is engineered to unlock the full potential of Galaxy AI for heavy multitaskers, powering a customized image enhancer that sharpens and smooths visuals across apps and content in real time. 
The world's first Privacy Display on mobile 

Meet built-in privacy screen on Galaxy S26 Ultra. When switched on, Privacy Display will protect your private information by hiding your full screen. Or, choose what you want to hide such as certain apps, notifications, or PINs. 
Upscale your viewing experience 

Color depth processing precision has improved, leveraging mDNle to ensure you see color and gradation as the creator intended. ProScaler also enhances details with Al processing improvements, resulting in clearer images. 
Play it cool with our largest Vapor Chamber ever 

Enjoy heavy-spec games and Galaxy Al thanks to Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy. And advanced thermal management from the new Vapor Chamber design, heat is dissipated faster and more efficiently than ever before. 
Ultra-fast charge. Ultra-long lasting 

Galaxy S26 Ultra supports Super Fast Charging 3.0, engineered to refuel your device at blazing speeds without impacting battery health or your time. 
Check the specs on our best camera system 

Galaxy S26 Ultra provides Nightography with wider apertures and noise reduction to deliver clear and detailed videos in low light. 
Clear and bright, even at night 

Wider apertures for 47% improved brightness on the 200 MP Wide camera, plus noise reduction deliver clear and detailed videos even in low-light environments. 
Super Steady Video. Even on the go 

Super Steady's Horizontal Lock feature combines expanded optical angles with gyro and acceleration sensors to recognize the direction of gravity and keep your shots level, even if you rotate a full 360°. 
High resolution with Ultra 200 MP 

With a 200 MP Wide camera sensor enhanced by our ProVisual Engine, Galaxy S26 Ultra is engineered to capture the finest details. High-res image data is analyzed in real time to maintain crisp textures and clarity. 
See the unseen 

Bring far away into focus, from 1x optical perfection to staggering 100x Al-powered Space Zoom stabilizing your view and enhancing clarity instantly. 
Studio-level edits. Built in. 

Get quick and easy photo editing with just a few words and Al. Add objects, such as accessories on photos of your pet by naturally describing the edits you wish to make, and Galaxy Al will realize your vision in minutes. 
From photos to stickers in a tap 

Mix sketches or photos with text that match your imagination. With a simple text description or a rough sketch outline, Galaxy Al produces the creations. Then, add the stickers to your keyboard or share it with your friends. 
Real-time suggestions when you need it 

The new Now Nudge can pick up on context on your screen and prompt you with helpful shortcuts. It intelligently minimizes the steps to your next action and even provides Autofill suggestions. 
On-device protection 

Our Personal Data Engine gathers and processes your personal data safely. Then it encrypts that data and saves it onto your device with KEEP and Knox Vault, making it harder for anyone else to gain access. 
Connected Security 

Knox Matrix Trust Chain technology provides security across Galaxy connected devices so you can monitor the security of other devices right from your Galaxy smartphone. 
Your Galaxy. Your way 

One UI 8.5 personalizes your Galaxy based on how you use it day-to-day. Designed to be simple and intuitive, contextual reminders from Galaxy Al features make daily tasks easier in just a tap.

items.text: Galaxy S26 Ultra provides Nightography with wider apertures and noise reduction to deliver clear and detailed videos in low light.

image.name: This image shows our best camera system which delivers clear & detailed videos and photos.

items.title: Clear and bright, even at night
items.text: Wider apertures for 47% improved brightness on the 200 MP Wide camera, plus noise reduction deliver clear and detailed videos even in low-light environments.

image.name: This image shows how the Nightography feature delivers clear videos even in low-light environment.

items.title: Super Steady Video. Even on the go
items.text: Super Steady's Horizontal Lock feature combines expanded optical angles with gyro and acceleration sensors to recognize the direction of gravity and keep your shots level, even if you rotate a full 360°.

image.name: This image shows how the frame remains steady, even on the go with Horizontal lock feature.

items.title: High resolution with Ultra 200 MP
items.text: With a 200 MP Wide camera sensor enhanced by our ProVisual Engine, Galaxy S26 Ultra is engineered to capture the finest details. High-res image data is analyzed in real time to maintain crisp textures and clarity.

image.name: With 200MP high resolution camera, this image shows finest details with crisp textures & clarity.

items.title: See the unseen
items.text: Bring far away into focus, from 1x optical perfection to staggering 100x Al-powered Space Zoom stabilizing your view and enhancing clarity instantly.

image.name: With 100x AI-powered Space Zoom, this image shows complete clarity with zoom feature.

items.title: Studio-level edits. Built in.
items.text: Get quick and easy photo editing with just a few words and Al. Add objects, such as accessories on photos of your pet by naturally describing the edits you wish to make, and Galaxy Al will realize your vision in minutes.

image.name: This image talks about the Photo Asisst feature of Galaxy S26 Ultra.

items.title: From photos to stickers in a tap
items.text: Mix sketches or photos with text that match your imagination. With a simple text description or a rough sketch outline, Galaxy Al produces the creations. Then, add the stickers to your keyboard or share it with your friends.

image.name: This image shows a cute dog demonstrating how one can easily generate stickers from photos.

items.title: Real-time suggestions when you need it
items.text: The new Now Nudge can pick up on context on your screen and prompt you with helpful shortcuts. It intelligently minimizes the steps to your next action and even provides Autofill suggestions.

image.name: This image shows the quick shortcuts through Samsung UI one can use in real-time.

items.title: On-device protection
items.text: Our Personal Data Engine gathers and processes your personal data safely. Then it encrypts that data and saves it onto your device with KEEP and Knox Vault, making it harder for anyone else to gain access.

image.name: This image is of Knox Vault showing one's data is saved securely on his or her device.

items.title: Connected Security
items.text: Knox Matrix Trust Chain technology provides security across Galaxy connected devices so you can monitor the security of other devices right from your Galaxy smartphone.

image.name: This image is of Knox Vault showing one&#39;s data is saved securely on his or her device.

items.title: Your Galaxy. Your way
items.text: One UI 8.5 personalizes your Galaxy based on how you use it day-to-day. Designed to be simple and intuitive, contextual reminders from Galaxy Al features make daily tasks easier in just a tap.

image.name: This image shows One UI 8.5 for Samsung UI
